bloodGroupShare._method: DERIVED: Agrawal 2014 Table 5, West region (Mumbai centre, n=2220): A 23.69%, B 32.74%, O 36.75%, AB 6.80%; Rh(D)+ 92.97%, Rh(D)- 7.02%. The paper reports ABO and Rh separately, so 8-group shares = ABO share x Rh share (assumes independence), renormalised to sum to 1.

surgeAssumptions._status: MODEL ASSUMPTIONS, not measured data. No published flood-specific blood-usage data was found.
surgeAssumptions.reasoning: Trauma figures from Israeli MCI series (soffer2008, shinar2006) with Las Vegas 2017 as ceiling (lozada2018); city-wide 2-3x from ilmoh. Floods kill mostly by drowning rather than haemorrhage, so a lower 1.5x RBC multiplier is used for 72 h. The platelet multiplier is a placeholder justified only indirectly by the post-flood leptospirosis surge (supe2018); no source quantifies post-flood platelet demand.
